messages.content: "Can you help me plan my day? I want to start from my home in New York and go to a chess club named 'Knight Gambit' located in Boston. I want to take the fastest route. After that, I want to go to another chess club named 'Rook Corner' in Philadelphia, again taking the fastest route. Finally, I want to return home, but this time I want to take the shortest route. Can you also provide me with the details of the events hosted by both chess clubs?"

function.name: chess_club_details_find
function.description: Provides details about a chess club, including location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The name of the chess club.

city.description: The city in which the chess club is located.

event.description: The event hosted by the club.

function.name: route_planner_calculate_route
function.description: Determines the best route between two points. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start.description: The starting point of the journey.

method.description: The method to use when calculating the route (default is 'fastest').

message.reasoning:
We need to call two functions: first find details of Knight Gambit in Boston; second find details of Rook Corner in Philadelphia. Then we need to calculate routes: from New York to Boston via fastest; Boston to Philadelphia via fastest; Philadelphia back to New York via shortest.

We have to produce a response that includes the details of events hosted by both clubs, and the routes.

We should call the functions accordingly. Let's do it step by step.

First, get details of Knight Gambit in Boston. Use chess_club_details_find with name="Knight Gambit", city="Boston". No event specified, so default null.

Second, get details of Rook Corner in Philadelphia. Use chess_club_details_find with name="Rook Corner", city="Philadelphia".

Third, calculate route from New York to Boston via fastest. Use route_planner_calculate_route with start="New York", destination="Boston", method="fastest".

Fourth, calculate route from Boston to Philadelphia via fastest. Use route_planner_calculate_route with start="Boston", destination="Philadelphia", method="fastest".

Fifth, calculate route from Philadelphia to New York via shortest. Use route_planner_calculate_route with start="Philadelphia", destination="New York", method="shortest".

We need to output all results. We'll call each function separately.
